# SmartBiz Coach — Practical Business Operating System & Market Square for Nigerian MSMEs

> SmartBiz Coach (https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/) is a Business Operating System and Digital Storefront platform built specifically for small business owners across Nigeria.

## Core Solutions

### 1. Central MSME Market Square & Personal Online Storefronts
- **Market Square URL**: https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/market
- **Personal Storefronts**: `https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/u/{brand_slug}`
- **Capabilities**: Connects buyers and sellers across Nigeria. Zero listing fees, tiered merchant verification badges (ID, CAC, Chamber), 1-click WhatsApp order routing, and Paystack checkout.
- **Nationwide Delivery Quoting**: Delivery fee configuration customized by merchants across Nigerian states and FCT.
- **Live Order Tracking**: Public tracking portal at `https://www.smartbizcoach.com.ng/track` allowing buyers to track delivery and confirm receipt.

### 2. Daily Retail POS & Camera Barcode Scanner
- **Capabilities**: Fast 5-second counter checkout supporting Cash, POS Card, Bank Transfer, and Customer Debt.
- **Smartphone Camera Barcode/QR Scanner**: Reads UPC/EAN barcodes using phone cameras with audio feedback.
- **Staff Shift Lock**: Supervisor passcode locks cashier screens from backdating records, modifying prices, or viewing owner profit margins.
- **Offline-First PWA Mode**: Records daily counter sales locally without active network and syncs when reconnected.

### 3. Gbege Book (Receivables & WhatsApp Debt Recovery)
- **Capabilities**: Dual ledger tracking customer debts and supplier payables.
- **WhatsApp Reminders**: Polite-to-formal escalation message templates via WhatsApp (`wa.me`) with Paystack payment links and bank details.
- **1-Tap Invoicing & Receipts**: Itemized PDF invoices/receipts with optional VAT and discount calculations.

### 4. Product Catalog Studio
- **Capabilities**: Enhances smartphone product photos with clean presentation backdrops and generates promotional sales captions for WhatsApp and Instagram.

### 5. SmartScore™ Readiness & Business Insights
- **SmartScore™ 300–850 Readiness Score**: Internal business readiness metric evaluating sales consistency, debt recovery velocity, and margin health.
- **Restock & Till Audit Alerts**: Highlights fast-moving stockout risks and unusual till discrepancies for owner review.

### 6. Tax Readiness Guide & CAC Registration Support
- **Small Company Tax Guidance**: Informational tax summary referencing Nigerian small-company CIT and VAT frameworks (informational only — not formal legal or tax advice; annual statutory returns remain mandatory).
- **CAC Registration Support**: Guided checklists and assisted filing requests for Business Name and Limited Liability Company registrations.
